correctness.rationale: Fixing one matching and contracting pairs converts the second matching into alternating cycles with logarithmic combinatorial component weight 1/(2ℓ) (including double edges) and normalizer [z^n](1−z)^−1/2. On a component, both alternating-start modal formulas hold everywhere precisely when each cyclic length-k=2d window contains a Bernoulli mark, treating short cycles by periodic extension. The k-state automaton forbids k successive unmarked bits; trace T_k^(2ℓ) sums valid closed cyclic state walks. The exponential cycle index gives exp(sum trace(T^(2ℓ)) z^ℓ/(2ℓ))=det(I−zT²)^−1/2. For q→0 and nq^k→t, only O_P(1) vertices belong to short cycles, so they contribute no failures, and the remaining O(n) length-k windows have bounded dependency degree with overlapping union >=k+1; Chen–Stein error O(nq^(2k)+nq^(k+1))→0, yielding joint independent Poisson(t) by E/F disjoint type counts. For diverging nq^k, choose Ω(n) disjoint long windows to bound success by exp(−Ω(nq^k)). Monotone reachability gives the two-point depth law; for fixed u∈(0,1), primitive T has simple Perron root ρ<1, and square-root singularity analysis gives Cρ^(2n). Independent exact-rational enumeration over matchings/valuations confirms n=1..3 and d=1..3 with q=3/5; finite evidence not asserted universal.
